#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent readback of the generated-manifest evidence packet."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/Users/dylan/.codex/worktrees/native-analytic-frames/shardloom-local-repo')
OUT = Path('/Users/dylan/LocalData/shardloom/required-execution-resources-20261010')
PACKET = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/required-execution-resources-generated-manifests-2026-10-11.json'
INDEX = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.json'
ANCESTOR = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/required-execution-resources-fixture-errors-2026-10-11.json'
HEAD = '45e911f4fa84e5afaa8bd35683b45faefc5fc178'
REPORT = OUT / 'generated-manifest-independent-281-report.json'
EXPECTED_RUNTIME = {
    'shardloom-cli/src/fixture_io.rs',
    'shardloom-cli/src/object_store_runtime.rs',
    'shardloom-cli/src/sqlite_local_runtime.rs',
    'shardloom-cli/src/table_lakehouse_runtime.rs',
    'shardloom-exec/src/live_memory.rs',
}
EXPECTED_DOCS = {
    'docs/architecture/phased-execution-plan.md',
    'docs/architecture/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.md',
    'docs/benchmarks/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.md',
}
GATES = {
    'fmt', 'default-clippy', 'default-tests', 'native-without-write',
    'native-write-only', 'reduced-writer-clippy', 'reduced-writer-tests',
    'lean-workspace', 'all-features', 'msrv-lean', 'msrv-native',
    'native-clippy', 'native-cli-tests', 'diff',
}
REGRESSIONS = [
    'table_lakehouse_runtime::tests::generated_table_record_keeps_escaped_capacity_charged_through_write',
    'object_store_runtime::tests::generated_object_manifest_reports_escaped_owned_capacity_and_recovers',
    'table_lakehouse_runtime::tests::generated_table_record_denial_precedes_manifest_replacement',
    'object_store_runtime::tests::generated_object_manifest_denial_restores_prior_objects_and_sidecars',
    'fixture_io::tests::write_rejects_vec_and_string_capacity_beyond_their_leases',
    'fixture_io::tests::write_rejects_foreign_payload_before_filesystem_effects',
    'fixture_io::tests::write_staging_competes_with_retained_credit_and_static_text_is_unowned',
    'fixture_io::tests::json_escaped_formats_into_text_and_releases_on_admission_failure',
]


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def read(path: Path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def git(*args: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()


def source_hashes() -> dict[str, str]:
    names = git('ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z').split('\0')
    result = {}
    for name in sorted(set(names)):
        path = ROOT / name
        if name and path.is_file() and (
            name.endswith(('.rs', '.py'))
            or path.name in ('Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock')
            or name.startswith('vendor/')
        ):
            result[name] = sha(path)
    return result


def identity(sources: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sources, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()


def check(condition: bool, message: str, failures: list[str]) -> None:
    if not condition:
        failures.append(message)


def check_receipt(path: Path, expected_status: str, failures: list[str]) -> dict:
    record = read(path)
    check(record.get('head') == HEAD, f'wrong HEAD in {path.name}', failures)
    check(record.get('status') == expected_status, f'wrong status in {path.name}', failures)
    check((record.get('returncode') == 0) == (record.get('status') == 'passed'),
          f'status/returncode mismatch in {path.name}', failures)
    check(record.get('direct_child_reaped') is True, f'child not reaped in {path.name}', failures)
    check(record.get('process_group_drained') is True, f'process group not drained in {path.name}', failures)
    check(record.get('timed_out') is False, f'timeout in {path.name}', failures)
    check(record.get('group_absence_unproved_at_cleanup') is False,
          f'process cleanup uncertain in {path.name}', failures)
    log_path = path.with_suffix('.log')
    log_hash = sha(log_path)
    check(record.get('log_sha256') == log_hash, f'log hash mismatch in {path.name}', failures)
    return {'receipt': record, 'receipt_sha256': sha(path), 'log_path': str(log_path),
            'log_sha256': log_hash, 'log_text': log_path.read_text()}


def check_embedded_record(item: dict, label: str, expected_status: str | None,
                          failures: list[str]) -> dict:
    path = Path(item['path'])
    embedded = item.get('receipt', {})
    status = embedded.get('status') if expected_status is None else expected_status
    inspected = check_receipt(path, status, failures)
    check(item.get('sha256') == inspected['receipt_sha256'], f'{label} receipt digest differs', failures)
    check(embedded == inspected['receipt'], f'{label} embedded receipt differs from file', failures)
    log = item.get('log', {})
    check(log.get('sha256') == inspected['log_sha256'], f'{label} embedded log digest differs', failures)
    check(log.get('text') == inspected['log_text'], f'{label} embedded log differs from file', failures)
    return inspected


def main() -> int:
    failures: list[str] = []
    packet = read(PACKET)
    packet_hash = sha(PACKET)
    index = read(INDEX)
    index_link = index.get('generated_manifest_review_correction', {})
    check(git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == HEAD, 'unexpected repository HEAD', failures)
    check(packet.get('reviewed_head') == HEAD, 'packet reviewed_head differs', failures)
    check(index_link.get('path') == PACKET.name, 'index packet path differs', failures)
    check(index_link.get('sha256') == packet_hash, 'index packet digest differs', failures)
    check(index_link.get('status') == packet.get('status'), 'index packet status differs', failures)
    check(packet.get('review_comment_ids') == [4240506962], 'review comment identity differs', failures)

    current_sources = source_hashes()
    source_identity = identity(current_sources)
    check(len(current_sources) == 1042, 'current source count is not 1,042', failures)
    check(packet.get('source_count') == 1042, 'packet source count is not 1,042', failures)
    check(packet.get('source_hashes') == current_sources, 'packet source map differs from current files', failures)
    check(packet.get('source_identity_sha256') == source_identity, 'packet source identity differs', failures)
    protocol = packet.get('protocol', {})
    results = packet.get('results', {})
    check(protocol.get('head') == HEAD and protocol.get('source_hashes') == current_sources,
          'frozen protocol source identity differs', failures)
    check(protocol.get('source_identity_sha256') == source_identity,
          'frozen protocol source digest differs', failures)
    check(set(protocol.get('commands', {})) == GATES, 'protocol does not contain exact 14 gates', failures)
    check(results.get('status') == 'passed', 'final source results are not passed', failures)
    check(results.get('protocol_sha256') == sha(OUT / 'resource-engine-26-protocol.json'),
          'protocol file digest differs from results', failures)
    checks = packet.get('checks', [])
    result_checks = results.get('checks', [])
    check(len(checks) == 14 and len(result_checks) == 14, 'final source receipt count is not 14', failures)
    check({item.get('name') for item in checks} == GATES, 'packet gate names differ', failures)
    check({item.get('name') for item in result_checks} == GATES, 'results gate names differ', failures)
    check({item.get('name') for item in checks} == {item.get('name') for item in result_checks},
          'packet and result gate sets differ', failures)
    source_receipt_evidence = {}
    for item in checks:
        receipt_path = Path(item['path'])
        inspected = check_receipt(receipt_path, 'passed', failures)
        check(item.get('sha256') == inspected['receipt_sha256'],
              f'receipt hash mismatch for gate {item.get("name")}', failures)
        check(item.get('receipt') == inspected['receipt'],
              f'embedded receipt mismatch for gate {item.get("name")}', failures)
        log = item.get('log', {})
        check(log.get('sha256') == inspected['log_sha256'],
              f'embedded log hash mismatch for gate {item.get("name")}', failures)
        check(log.get('text') == inspected['log_text'],
              f'embedded log differs for gate {item.get("name")}', failures)
        gate = item.get('name')
        check(inspected['receipt'].get('command') == protocol.get('commands', {}).get(gate),
              f'command mismatch for gate {gate}', failures)
        result_row = next((row for row in result_checks if row.get('name') == gate), {})
        check(result_row.get('receipt') == str(receipt_path), f'results receipt path mismatch for {gate}', failures)
        check(result_row.get('receipt_sha256') == inspected['receipt_sha256'],
              f'results receipt hash mismatch for {gate}', failures)
        check(result_row.get('log_sha256') == inspected['log_sha256'],
              f'results log hash mismatch for {gate}', failures)
        totals = item.get('rust_test_totals')
        if totals is not None:
            rows = re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;',
                              inspected['log_text'])
            actual = {key: sum(int(row[i]) for row in rows)
                      for i, key in enumerate(('passed', 'failed', 'ignored'))}
            check(totals == actual, f'Rust test totals mismatch for {gate}', failures)
            check(result_row.get('rust_test_totals') == actual, f'results totals mismatch for {gate}', failures)
            check(actual['passed'] > 0 and actual['failed'] == 0,
                  f'Rust tests did not pass for {gate}', failures)
        source_receipt_evidence[gate] = {
            'receipt_path': str(receipt_path),
            'receipt_sha256': inspected['receipt_sha256'],
            'log_sha256': inspected['log_sha256'],
            'rust_test_totals': totals,
        }

    check(packet.get('verified_regressions') == [name.split('::')[-1] for name in REGRESSIONS],
          'regression list differs from eight expected tests', failures)
    check(packet.get('new_regression_count') == 8, 'regression count is not eight', failures)
    regression_logs = {}
    for gate in ('default-tests', 'native-cli-tests'):
        text = next((item['log']['text'] for item in checks if item['name'] == gate), '')
        missing = [name for name in REGRESSIONS if f'test {name} ... ok' not in text]
        check(not missing, f'{gate} missing passing regressions: {missing}', failures)
        regression_logs[gate] = {'passed_names': [name for name in REGRESSIONS if f'test {name} ... ok' in text],
                                 'missing_names': missing}

    focused = packet.get('focused_manifest_checks', {})
    expected_focused = {
        'generated-manifest-focused-280': 'failed',
        'generated-manifest-focused-280b': 'failed',
        'generated-manifest-focused-280c': 'passed',
        'generated-manifest-helper-280': 'passed',
    }
    check(set(focused) == set(expected_focused), 'focused check set differs', failures)
    focused_evidence = {}
    for name, status in expected_focused.items():
        item = focused.get(name, {})
        inspected = check_embedded_record(item, name, status, failures)
        focused_evidence[name] = {'status': status, 'receipt_sha256': inspected['receipt_sha256'],
                                  'log_sha256': inspected['log_sha256']}
    log_280 = focused['generated-manifest-focused-280']['log']['text']
    check('no library targets found' in log_280 and 'running ' not in log_280,
          'initial focused attempt did not preserve no-library/no-test explanation', failures)
    check(re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;',
                     focused['generated-manifest-focused-280c']['log']['text']) == [('5', '0', '0')],
          'corrected focused test totals are not 5/0/0', failures)
    check(re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;',
                     focused['generated-manifest-helper-280']['log']['text']) == [('8', '0', '0')],
          'fixture_io helper test totals are not 8/0/0', failures)
    retry_log = focused['generated-manifest-focused-280b']['log']['text']
    check(re.findall(r'test result: FAILED\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;',
                     retry_log) == [('3', '2', '0')],
          'preserved failed retry does not show 3 passed / 2 assertion failures', failures)
    check(len(re.findall(r'^test .* \.\.\. FAILED$', retry_log, re.M)) == 2,
          'preserved failed retry does not contain exactly two test failures', failures)
    for name in REGRESSIONS[:2]:
        check(f'test {name} ... FAILED' in retry_log,
              f'preserved failed retry lacks expected assertion case {name}', failures)
    explanations = packet.get('failed_attempt_explanations', {})
    check('no library target' in explanations.get('generated-manifest-focused-280', '').lower(),
          'first focused failure explanation was not preserved', failures)
    check('trimmed idempotency keys' in explanations.get('generated-manifest-focused-280b', '').lower(),
          'retry assertion explanation was not preserved', failures)
    for name in REGRESSIONS[:4]:
        test_name = name.split('::')[-1]
        check(f'test {name} ... ok' in focused['generated-manifest-focused-280c']['log']['text'],
              f'focused corrected log lacks {name}', failures)
    for name in REGRESSIONS[4:]:
        check(f'test {name} ... ok' in focused['generated-manifest-helper-280']['log']['text'],
              f'helper log lacks {name}', failures)

    failed_finalizer = packet.get('failed_finalizer_attempt', {})
    failed_record = failed_finalizer.get('record', {})
    failed_evidence = check_embedded_record(failed_record, 'failed initial finalizer', 'failed', failures)
    check('AssertionError' in failed_evidence['log_text'], 'failed finalizer traceback was not preserved', failures)
    failed_generator = failed_finalizer.get('generator', {})
    failed_generator_path = Path(failed_generator.get('path', ''))
    check(failed_generator_path.is_file(), 'failed finalizer source was not preserved', failures)
    if failed_generator_path.is_file():
        check(sha(failed_generator_path) == failed_generator.get('sha256'),
              'failed finalizer source hash mismatch', failures)
        check(failed_generator_path.read_text() == failed_generator.get('text'),
              'failed finalizer embedded source differs', failures)
    check('module path' in failed_finalizer.get('reason', '').lower(),
          'failed-finalizer correction reason is missing', failures)
    finalizer_path = OUT / 'generated-manifest-evidence-finalize-281b.json'
    finalizer = check_receipt(finalizer_path, 'passed', failures)
    finalizer_log = finalizer['log_text']
    check(finalizer['receipt'].get('command', [])[-1:] == [
        '/Users/dylan/LocalData/shardloom/required-execution-resources-20261010/finalize_generated_manifest_evidence.py'],
        'successful finalizer command differs', failures)
    check('"status": "passed"' in finalizer_log, 'successful finalizer output is absent', failures)
    original_helper = focused.get('generated-manifest-helper-280', {})
    check(original_helper.get('receipt', {}).get('status') == 'passed',
          'original helper test receipt was not retained', failures)
    intermediate = packet.get('preserved_intermediate_checks', {})
    check(set(intermediate) == set(expected_focused),
          'preserved intermediate receipt set differs from focused receipts', failures)
    for name, status in expected_focused.items():
        preserved_item = intermediate.get(name, {})
        check_embedded_record(preserved_item, f'preserved intermediate {name}', status, failures)
        check(preserved_item.get('sha256') == focused.get(name, {}).get('sha256'),
              f'preserved intermediate receipt differs from focused item {name}', failures)
        check(preserved_item.get('log', {}).get('sha256') == focused.get(name, {}).get('log', {}).get('sha256'),
              f'preserved intermediate log differs from focused item {name}', failures)
    packet_generator = packet.get('generator', {})
    packet_generator_path = Path(packet_generator.get('path', ''))
    check(packet_generator_path.is_file(), 'finalizer generator source is missing', failures)
    if packet_generator_path.is_file():
        check(sha(packet_generator_path) == packet_generator.get('sha256'),
              'finalizer generator source hash differs', failures)
        check(packet_generator_path.read_text() == packet_generator.get('text'),
              'finalizer generator source text differs', failures)

    support = packet.get('support', {})
    support_result = support.get('results', {})
    support_rows = support.get('reports', [])
    raw_support_rows = support_result.get('reports', [])
    check(support_result.get('status') == 'passed', 'support suite is not passed', failures)
    check(len(raw_support_rows) == 14 and len(support_rows) == 14, 'support report count is not 14', failures)
    check(support_result.get('source_identity_sha256') == source_identity,
          'support result source identity differs', failures)
    check(len({row.get('name') for row in raw_support_rows}) == 14, 'support report names are not unique', failures)
    support_evidence = []
    for item in support_rows:
        if 'path' in item:
            path = Path(item['path'])
            actual_hash = sha(path)
            check(item.get('sha256') == actual_hash, f'support report hash mismatch: {path.name}', failures)
            raw_item = next((row for row in raw_support_rows if row.get('path') == item['path']), {})
            check(raw_item.get('sha256') == actual_hash, f'raw support report hash mismatch: {path.name}', failures)
            check(item.get('text') == path.read_text(), f'embedded support report differs: {path.name}', failures)
            report_data = read(path)
            check(report_data.get('status', 'passed') == 'passed', f'support report not passed: {path.name}', failures)
            support_evidence.append({'path': str(path), 'sha256': actual_hash})
        else:
            check(item in raw_support_rows, 'inline support report differs from result', failures)
            check(bool(item.get('stdout')) and not item.get('stderr'), 'inline support report unsuccessful', failures)
            support_evidence.append({'name': item.get('name'), 'inline': True})

    changed = packet.get('changed_files', {})
    file_hashes = {}
    for name, entry in changed.items():
        before = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{HEAD}:{name}'], cwd=ROOT)
        before_hash = hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()
        after_hash = sha(ROOT / name)
        check(entry.get('before_sha256') == before_hash, f'pre-change file hash mismatch: {name}', failures)
        check(entry.get('after_sha256') == after_hash, f'post-change file hash mismatch: {name}', failures)
        file_hashes[name] = {'before_sha256': before_hash, 'after_sha256': after_hash}
    runtime_changed = sorted(name for name in changed if name in current_sources)
    docs_changed = {name for name in changed if name.startswith('docs/')}
    check(set(runtime_changed) == EXPECTED_RUNTIME, 'changed runtime set is not exact five', failures)
    check(docs_changed == EXPECTED_DOCS, 'changed documentation set differs', failures)
    actual_diff_names = set(git('diff', '--name-only', HEAD).splitlines())
    index_name = str(INDEX.relative_to(ROOT))
    check(actual_diff_names == set(changed) | {index_name},
          'repository diff contains omitted or unexpected files', failures)
    source_patch = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', HEAD, '--', *sorted(EXPECTED_RUNTIME)], cwd=ROOT, text=True)
    check(source_patch == packet.get('source_patch'), 'packet source patch differs from exact diff', failures)
    docs_patch = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', HEAD, '--', *sorted(EXPECTED_DOCS)], cwd=ROOT, text=True)
    check(docs_patch == packet.get('documentation_patch'), 'packet documentation patch differs', failures)
    doc_content = packet.get('documentation_content', {})
    documentation_hashes = {}
    for name in EXPECTED_DOCS:
        current = ROOT / name
        captured = doc_content.get(name, {})
        digest = sha(current)
        check(captured.get('sha256') == digest and captured.get('text') == current.read_text(),
              f'documented file capture differs: {name}', failures)
        check(changed.get(name, {}).get('after_sha256') == digest,
              f'documented file after hash differs: {name}', failures)
        documentation_hashes[name] = digest

    ancestor = packet.get('ancestor_evidence', {})
    ancestor_entry = index.get('fixture_error_review_correction', {})
    check(ancestor.get('key') == 'fixture_error_review_correction', 'ancestor key is not fixture_error_review_correction', failures)
    check(ancestor_entry.get('path') == ANCESTOR.name, 'main index ancestor path differs', failures)
    check(ancestor.get('path') == str(ANCESTOR), 'packet ancestor path differs', failures)
    ancestor_hash = sha(ANCESTOR)
    check(ancestor.get('sha256') == ancestor_hash == ancestor_entry.get('sha256'),
          'ancestor packet digest chain differs', failures)
    ancestor_packet = read(ANCESTOR)
    check(ancestor_packet.get('source_identity_sha256') == ancestor.get('source_identity_sha256'),
          'ancestor source identity differs', failures)
    check(set(current_sources) == set(ancestor_packet.get('source_hashes', {})),
          'ancestor/current source path sets differ', failures)
    source_differences = sorted(name for name, digest in current_sources.items()
                                if digest != ancestor_packet['source_hashes'][name])
    check(source_differences == sorted(EXPECTED_RUNTIME), 'ancestor source differences not exactly five runtime files', failures)
    prior_independent = ancestor_entry.get('independent_readback', {})
    if prior_independent:
        prior_readback_path = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence' / prior_independent['path']
        check(sha(prior_readback_path) == prior_independent.get('sha256'),
              'fixture-error independent readback hash differs', failures)
    else:
        check(False, 'fixture-error independent readback link is absent', failures)

    preserved = packet.get('preserved_artifact_sha256', {})
    preserved_hashes = {}
    for name, expected_hash in preserved.items():
        path = ROOT / name
        actual_hash = sha(path)
        check(actual_hash == expected_hash, f'preserved evidence changed: {name}', failures)
        preserved_hashes[name] = actual_hash
    check(bool(preserved_hashes), 'preserved artifact map is empty', failures)

    check(packet.get('original_complete_workflows_rerun') is False,
          'packet claims complete workflows were rerun', failures)
    check(packet.get('performance_claim') is False, 'packet makes a performance claim', failures)
    check(packet.get('whole_process_memory_limit_enforced') is False,
          'packet claims whole-process limit enforcement', failures)
    check(packet.get('fallback_attempted') is False and packet.get('external_engine_invoked') is False,
          'packet external engine flags are not false', failures)
    check(packet.get('intermediate_checks_establish_final_source_acceptance') is False,
          'packet overstates intermediate checks', failures)

    report = {
        'status': 'passed' if not failures else 'failed',
        'packet_path': str(PACKET),
        'packet_sha256': packet_hash,
        'index_path': str(INDEX),
        'index_sha256': sha(INDEX),
        'head': HEAD,
        'source_count': len(current_sources),
        'source_identity_sha256': source_identity,
        'runtime_changed_files': runtime_changed,
        'source_differences_from_fixture_error_ancestor': source_differences,
        'changed_file_hashes': file_hashes,
        'source_patch_match': source_patch == packet.get('source_patch'),
        'documentation_hashes': documentation_hashes,
        'documentation_patch_match': docs_patch == packet.get('documentation_patch'),
        'fresh_gate_count': len(checks),
        'fresh_gate_receipts': source_receipt_evidence,
        'new_regressions': REGRESSIONS,
        'regression_logs': regression_logs,
        'focused_receipts': focused_evidence,
        'failed_finalizer': {
            'receipt_path': failed_record.get('path'),
            'receipt_sha256': failed_evidence['receipt_sha256'],
            'log_sha256': failed_evidence['log_sha256'],
            'source_path': str(failed_generator_path),
            'source_sha256': sha(failed_generator_path) if failed_generator_path.is_file() else None,
        },
        'successful_finalizer': {
            'receipt_path': str(finalizer_path),
            'receipt_sha256': finalizer['receipt_sha256'],
            'log_sha256': finalizer['log_sha256'],
        },
        'support_report_count': len(support_evidence),
        'support_reports': support_evidence,
        'ancestor_packet': {'path': str(ANCESTOR), 'sha256': ancestor_hash,
                            'source_identity_sha256': ancestor_packet.get('source_identity_sha256')},
        'preserved_artifact_count': len(preserved_hashes),
        'preserved_artifact_hashes': preserved_hashes,
        'failures': failures,
    }
    REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'status': report['status'], 'report': str(REPORT),
                      'failures': failures}, indent=2))
    return 0 if not failures else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
